title: Damaged meal container makes the food unusable
facts_text: I verified my account and order. It was delivered two hours ago. The noodle bowl's container was crushed and the food spilled into the delivery bag, so that meal is unusable. The other items are fine. I took a photo of the damaged container and spill.
request: Please refund the noodle bowl and its tax.
